experiment: exp55 the window protocol on GEOID-Flood, event by event

config.s1_db: 10 log10(max(x, 1e-06)), non-finite and > 1000.0 set to nodata

A.name: permanent water from the pre-event S2

B.name: water after the event from the post-event S1

C.name: flooded water only from the post-event S1

config.prereg: P1 task A: confidence beats NDWI level on more events than it loses (one-sided sign test over events p < 0.05) and pooled lead >= 0.001; P2 task B: the same against S1 level; P3 median over events of confidence's capture at 5% >= 0.25 on tasks A and B

A.name: permanent water from the pre-event S2

B.name: water after the event from the post-event S1

C.name: flooded water only from the post-event S1
